retrieval_class: rendered text via the Arena page reader; direct HTTPS to nfl.com returns curl code 000 from the build sandbox
arithmetic: every row re-derived: W+L+T, PCT=(W+T/2)/(W+L+T), NET=PF-PA

league_identity.check: PF == PA and W == L, else the build aborts

withheld_columns: the three unnamed 3-part records, because the rendered column order does not identify which is HOME, ROAD, DIV or CONF
the two unnamed decimal columns for the same reason
scope: Values as printed on 2026-11-14. Not a forecast and not a market price.
